name: Hoyales de Roa (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Hoyales de Roa (a castle beneath stars on red).
history: Municipal flag of Hoyales de Roa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Hoyales de Roa arms — castle beneath stars
